content.title: INLINE VALIDATION & DATA ASSESSMENT
content.content:
- **Inline data validation**: The Validate Snap and Filter Snap enforce data quality constraints within the pipeline — null checks, range validation, referential integrity, format validation, and custom expression-based rules. Invalid records are rejected; flagged with an error code, routed to an error pipeline, or quarantined to a DQ hold table based on configurable policy.

- **Automated data assessment**: Schema inference during pipeline development automatically profiles source data — null patterns, data type distributions, row counts, distinct value counts, min/max values, and frequency histograms. This provides integration developers with a quality baseline before production deployment and surfaces data quality issues early in the development lifecycle.

- **Centralised, reusable validation policies**: Validation logic is encapsulated in shared child pipelines — promoted through the standard Dev → Test → Prod lifecycle and reused across multiple integration projects. Changes to validation rules are deployed once and propagate to all consuming pipelines automatically.
